numericalMethod.time: median of7 correlated batch samples per process, then median of3 process medians; divide by actual sharedN for ms/iteration
numericalMethod.throughput: processed bytes per batch ×1000/process median batch ms; MiB=1048576bytes. Construction-only control has0units, byte rate not applicable.
numericalMethod.ratio: B median ms/iteration divided by A median ms/iteration; >1 favorsA. Paired process ratios are also retained, not pooled as21independent observations.
numericalMethod.rss: Node public peakProcessRssKilobytes field retained; converted toMiB by/1024. Not JS heap, linear-memory capacity or unique physical memory.
numericalMethod.stages: Separate host-observed compile/binding load, instantiate, first identity export, setup, first batch and whole-worker stages; no isolated physical/cold startup claim.

limitations: Shared desktop/frequency/thermal/background variance; n3 process medians with seven correlated retained samples, no significance claim
ExactlyAB/BA/AB,2:1 first-arm imbalance; no second order matrix or extra independent samples inferred
One fresh public one-iteration pilot per arm/family/comparison chooses a shared1..16 N using the slower arm; all pilot costs/chosen counts preserved, no clipping
Host performance.now surrounds awaited WIT batch only; progress/checksum parsing/RSS reads occur outside timed intervals
Unchanged per-byte consume validation plus FNV Math.imul remains inside trace=false workload and may dominate; this is not isolated stream bookkeeping
Compile/binding load, instantiate, first batch and whole worker elapsed are separate observables, not isolated snapshot/deployed or process startup estimates
PeakRSS includes file hashes/V8/allocator retention; capacity/grow counts unavailable, no JS heap ownership inference
Same-engine is registered JS binding versus identical bundled JS factory on common native slots, not a C++ stream state machine
Whole-profile is ON versusOFF with identical canonical bundle; stock is a different provider/scheduler and ambient Web dependency domain
All original28 trace counterexamples remain;8newcommonbyte correctness cases do not establish general streams parity; three raw controls are never subtracted

Actual compact batch returns/checksums are not retained. Authenticated source exact() checks plus terminal completion support worker validation; this reader cannot independently decode absent per-batch returns. Separate308-observation correctness has fullraw evidence.
No artifact or workload execution by numerical reader; integrity/source closure is independently reviewed in a separate packet.
Final component sizes are one actual artifact perarm; no distribution, raw/optimized split or compressed delivery-size inference.
Public process RSS includes V8, source/hash validation and allocator retention; smaller component size is not a heap/memory advantage.
